title: SawmillAlert Log: Campaign SA-0414-07 Fails, PG-14 and Kestrel Ridge Down

fields.logSource: Campaign SA-0414-07 delivery log / RCC operator journal

lines.msg: Campaign SA-0414-07 launched by rcc.console3 | channel VOICE | target zones CR-07, KS-04 | 214 contacts loaded
Carrier gateway PEAKLINE_WIRELESS: failure rate 58% over last 120 s | cause NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE | serving sector PG-14
Carrier status feed PEAKLINE_WIRELESS: site PG-14 OUT OF SERVICE | reason: backup battery exhausted (commercial power lost 08:02)
Carrier status feed PEAKLINE_WIRELESS: site KESTREL RIDGE OUT OF SERVICE | reason: backup battery exhausted

Operator journal (RCC Supervisor): Peakline Wireless NOC by phone 15:45. PG-14 and Kestrel Ridge down. Portable generator sent up Kestrel Springs Rd cannot get through outbound traffic. No voice or data on most of KS-04 and CR 68 east of Coyote Draw. NOC asks: can the co-op energize Circuit 12 just to their site?
Voice campaign SA-0414-07 to CR-07/KS-04 COMPLETE | 214 attempted | 61 connected | 153 FAILED (no network)
Failed contacts by zone: KS-04 = 118, CR-07 = 35 | includes 9 medical needs registry households
Auto-retry scheduled 16:02 for 153 failed contacts | carrier status for PG-14 and Kestrel Ridge still OUT OF SERVICE

Operator journal (RCC Supervisor): Radio 15:50, Unit 2S30 Deputy Ruiz. Phone and MDT dead. Sweeping KS-04 door to door. Stonebridge reports 12 non-ambulatory residents waiting at the front door for wheelchair vans and the county bus. No vans have arrived.

instructorNote: This is a technical hurdle: alerts can no longer reach most of KS-04 and CR-07. Dispatch should move field units to radio and tell the EOC which zones cannot receive alerts. The Sheriff should order logged door-to-door sweeps and escalate transport for Stonebridge, where the bus and ambulance request is still unacknowledged. The co-op Operations Director should refuse to re-energize Circuit 12 while the fire is active and KS-04 is under a status, and should offer the carrier help getting its generator up Kestrel Springs Road through the EOC instead.
